notes.title: TEVI Adds New Language Support and OST Tracks on Steam!
notes.content:
TEVI now supports more languages on Steam! 

[h3][b]Newly added languages:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Korean（한국어）
[*] Ukrainian（українська）
[*] Russian（Русский）

Additionally, [b]TEVI's digital OST has been updated with tracks from Boss Rush and Circus Parkour.[/b] If you've purchased the OST, don't forget to check out the new tracks and dive back into the colorful soundscape of TEVI!



[h3][b]★ To celebrate this update, TEVI's main game and digital OST are 25% OFF on Steam from now until July 11.（PT）Don't miss this opportunity to grab them![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230650/TEVI/

-
If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please report them via the Steam discussion board or the official TEVI Discord. Thank you for your love and support.

notes.title: v1.0~1.2 Updates & Future Plans
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We would like to express our gratitude to all players for your assistance and feedback on TEVI so far. Every review and comment helps us continuously improve the game and for that, we are deeply thankful.

The game has been updated to version v1.2, and there are still many adjustments and fixes planned. Although it will take time, we will strive to improve TEVI with continuous updates of the game based on your participation.


[h2]Major Update: Versions v1.0~v1.2[/h2]

[h3]Update Summary:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Colosseum Boss Rush Challenge
[*] Added Circus Parkour Challenge
[*] Added deeper difficulty variation system
[*] Added DPS Training Room / Mushroom Stress Relief Room
[*] Added special challenges in hidden areas
[*] Added Voice Replay feature in dialogue records
[*] Fine-tuned some character portraits (corresponding to future skin updates)
[/list]

[h3]Experience Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved some terrain and maze structures / level configurations / game processes
[*] Improved exploration guidance / items / display methods for map connections
[*] Optimized controls / custom settings
[*] Adjusted dynamic difficulty variation for hard mode and above
[*] Added "Map Auto-Marking" feature to automatically mark visible resource items on the map
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some dialogues, translations, and voice errors
[*] Fixed some reported or known errors
[/list]

[h2]Future Plans for TEVI:[/h2]

We plan to update localization in the future, and detailed announcements will be made when ready. The languages ​​expected to be updated include:
[list]
[*] Korean (한국어)
[*] Ukrainian (українська)
[*] Russian (Русский)
[*] Spanish (español)
[/list]

The team is also developing a new DLC, which will continue the main storyline, featuring new areas, enemies, and bosses. Special skins for Tevi are also in preparation, so stay tuned for more news!

[h2]★ From now until 10:00a.m. of May 3rd (PDT), get 20% off on TEVI![/h2]

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230650/TEVI/

-
If you have any bugs or suggestions to report, please share with  us through the Steam Discussion Board or the official TEVI Discord. Thank you for your love and support.

notes.title: Boss Rush Update and future content announcment
notes.content:
[h2]Boss Rush access method[/h2]

[b]After completing all main chapters, head to the colosseum in the bottom right of Valhalla, where you can find the Mysterious Attendant to initiate the Boss Rush![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616278/49fb08fa65d0292033349ad8d73d8bb97b1d741d.jpg[/img]

[b]The ultimate gauntlet has arrived: Boss Rush mode, where you'll face off against every boss in the game. Brace yourself for back-to-back smackdowns, during which special hidden events can be triggered! Dive in and find out what lies in wait![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616278/15e0a5d9a21843e761a70b373bde8ae8fc1b5dca.png[/img]


[h2]New features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added "The Colosseum" Boss Rush Mode, which features more than 3 different difficulty levels. Players can access the colosseum after clearing the game. Once any Boss Rush is completed, the colosseum becomes accessible in any save file.
[*] Added three new special battles, which can be accessed by following the new post game objectives.
[*] Added 10 new achievements
[*] Added "Auto Pin" feature. When players see an item or any resource block, it will be auto-pinned to the map, even if they have not collected it. (This feature is on by default. Items hidden in blocks or fake walls will not pinned until the block or fake wall is removed)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616278/cd69d50aa1d6a44acf77c18806f34357550e40e6.png[/img]


[*] Optimized the "Always display map connections" feature. Now almost all connections are shown. (Feature is on by default)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616278/0edae21f3edd4f027390b91b73a155a417c9f115.png[/img]


[*] Optimized Misty Maze "2": Changed one of the rooms so players can reach the end and clear the fog sooner.
[*] Optimized [spoiler]Dreamer's Keep[/spoiler]: Made changes and added a simpler gimmick to make it easier to navigate.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed missing hint in Library Key's English description
[*] Fixed player's inability to apply "Impassioned" debuff to the boss if player DPS is very high
[*] Fixed Chapter 3 "BOSS 1" using a phase 1 attack during phase 2 if player DPS is very high
[*] Fixed an attack pattern of Chapter 8 "BOSS 2"
[*] Fixed both bosses in [spoiler]Dreamer's Keep[/spoiler] sharing the same equipment in Free Roam mode
[*] And many minor bug fixes
[/list]

[h2]What's coming next?[/h2]

Currently we are developing a new major DLC, which continues the story after the main game with new areas, enemies and bosses.

There are also two new skins planned for Tevi.
More news will be announced later!

Meanwhile, there will be some new free content (The Circus, which focuses on platforming challenges) and features (For example: Loop Bosses+++ which was previously exclusive to the demo Version) before the DLCs release. Please stay tuned!

-
If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions to report, please do so through the Steam discussion board or the official TEVI Discord. Thank you for your support and care.

notes.title: Patch Note 1.02
notes.content:
[h2]New changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 5 new Sigils in craft menu
[*] Added a new Custom Game setting
[*] Players can now change custom game settings in Tevi's bed (Not all custom game settings can be changed)
[*] Players can now change difficulty in Tevi's bed to [spoiler]Infernal BBQ[/spoiler] once they beaten it, in all the save files
[*] Players can now upgrade "Explorer's Compass" once cleared at least three Memine Challenges
[*] New setting option in the setting menu, which allows players to trigger the Jetpack with just holding "JUMP"
[*] Added shortcut to retry/abort during Memine Challenge
[*] Added a small hint in Misty Maze about how to solve it, and now it is now possible to remove the fog once the player reaches the last room 
[*] Added visual hint in [spoiler]Dreamer's Keep[/spoiler]
[*] Requirement of some unlockable settings are lowered

[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Balance to chapter 6+ bosses' health, attack and break gauge (Hard+ and higher)
[*] All Sigils with "All melee attack power +1.5%" effect changed to "All melee attack power +3.0%"
[*] Sigil "EP Booster: Melee Menace" effect changed (1.5% -> 3.0% , EP +1 -> EP +2)
[*] Sigil "EP Booster: Perfectionist" negative effect changed (2 -> 3)
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] About the Hellfire underflow bug. The bug behavior is kept as we like the strat, but in greater difficulties, this bug is now less effective.
[*] Fixed "Random Sigil" mode's seed bug
[*] Fixed Sable C's bomb having the same break mod as cluster/cross bomb's (Break effect is kept but less effective)
[*] Fixed Chapter 6 "Boss 2" refight not triggering
[*] Fixed Chapter 8 "Boss 3" : Sometimes dark fog does not disappear when boss battles starts
[*] Safemode now deletes corrupted setting file (not save files)
[*] Game will now stop loading corrupted save/setting files to prevent crashes. If tevisystem.sav is corrupted, the game will try to recreate a new copy based on your Steam Achievement process. [b](If you lost your tevisystem.sav, you can force this recreation by pressing F9 on the title screen, a sound effect will be played once it is done)[/b]
[*] ...and some minor bug fixes
[/list]

[h2]Hotfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Train/Airship NPC Dialog box text position
[*] Fixed a room in [spoiler]Cloister of Redemption[/spoiler] 
[*] Chapter 6+ bosses break gauge balance now based on number of Cherry Bunny Potion collected
[*] Now Chapter 5 bosses no longer affected by the balance change
[/list]

[h2]What's coming next:[/h2]
As previously mentioned, in next update we will focus on the [b]Boss Rush[/b] in the Colosseum. Also, we will add the option to show room connections in the map system without discover them first (togglable in setting menu). 
There will be more updates in the future. Please stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Note 1.01b & Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
[h2]New changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added two new Custom Game settings (Custom Game is unlocked by completing the game)
[*] Basic carrying capacity is now 3 consumables
[*] Changed some rooms/item blocks for better flow of gameplay 
[*] Added Voice Replay function in "Chat Log"
[*] Explorer's Compass Level 2 now detects resources
[*] Jetpack now activated faster
[*] Now it is possible to enter the final area earlier in Free Roam
[*] Changed position of "Slick Boots", and "Rabi Boots" in Free Roam mode for easier access
[*] Chapter 8 "BOSS 3" : Added information for a certain attack 
[*]Player can now set how to trigger "Tornado Spin" and "Spanner Bash" in setting menu:
[code]- Strong Attacks Control : Can be activated after melee attack hits
or
- Strong Attacks Control : Can be activated anytime

*In some non-battle situations this setting is ignored
*1.01b fixed in some rooms when player is near white blocks, this setting is not ignored[/code][/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some event voices not playing correctly
[*] Fixed a rare situation where the boss break meter becomes very hard to break
[*] Fixed Notebook's "Boss Data" showing incorrect value of Total Damage Dealt
[*] Fixed achievement "One Trick Bunny" not unlocking
[*] Fixed game freezing if Alt+Tab/unfocus the game for too long period of time 
[*] Fixed boss's stats after clearing the game
[*] Fixed frame rate related bug with sigil "MP Quicken: Bloodlust" 
[*] Fixed issue with "Elite Challenge E" which sometimes would stop spawning enemies when frame rate is very high
[*] Finishing an Elite Challenge now displays the resources obtained (Before this patch, resources are obtained but did not show on screen)
[/list]

[h2]What's coming next:[/h2]

First, thank you everyone for playing our game! 
Currently there are some areas in the game that are tricky to navigate, especially when trying to 100% them. We will optimize those areas in upcoming patches.
For the new content, the first free update will be [b]Boss Rush[/b] in the colosseum. There may be some twist in this Boss Rush?
There will be more updates in the future, please stay tuned!

notes.title: TEVI Launches November 30th!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=16xa4ew57Tg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Launch Date: November 30th, 2023, 10AM (GMT+8)[/b][/h2]
(6 pm PST | 9 pm EST | 11 am JST)

Dear TEVI players, the wait is finally over! We are thrilled to announce the official launch date of TEVI!

The game will be officially available on Steam and Switch platforms on November 30, 2023, and will be gradually released on concoles such as PlayStation and Xbox in 2024. TEVI will support English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.


[h2][b]Demo Version Available![/b][/h2]
We sincerely appreciate the support of players during the playtest event. We have gathered valuable feedback and opinion, which we have taken those into account to adjust the game!

Therefore, we are excited to introduce the TEVI demo version. Players can play and share it with friends at any time.

In the demo version, we have made slight adjustments to the gameplay and item acquisition for players to experience the core content of the game much quicker.

※ The full version will include more systems, skills, areas, around 200 different enemies, and over 300 collectible items.


[h2][b]Wishlist Now![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230650/TEVI/

If you encounter any in-game errors while playing the demo, please visit the TEVI Discord error reporting section or the TEVI Steam discussion board and follow the specified format for reporting.
